impl.summary: People can now look around Gaussian splats inside Fuobe. They no longer have to download them to SuperSplat. I chose Spark 2.3.1 (@sparkjsdev/spark, MIT, World Labs) as the renderer and load it only through a dynamic import. The new SplatViewer works on result cards ('View in 3D' plus a '3D' choice in the card's radio row). It also works in the full-screen viewer, which the Library's 3D tab and the 'View in 3D' output action both open through ModelViewer and the new SplatPanel. It has drag to orbit, pinch and wheel zoom, keyboard controls, Reset view, Turn it over, a light / grey / dark background, the 'Hide faint haze' opacity cut-off (0.05 for Idol 3D on both engines, 0 for TripoSplat) and 'Save a still', which saves a PNG to Library Uploads (hidden for guests). The orbit video or picture stays as the poster while loading. It is also the fallback when there is no WebGL2, when the file is over the size limit (48 MB on touch screens, 160 MB elsewhere), and in the full-screen viewer under prefers-reduced-motion until the user picks 'Look around in 3D'. The download buttons are kept. Demo mode now returns real splats: an .spz with the orbit video on the open engine and a .ply on the cloud. Nothing existed for this before; the plan's pieces were all gaps. What was already there and reused: splatFormatOf, model3dView's splat field, the storage MIME types for ply/spz/ksplat, and the card's splat radio row.

findings.summary: The full-screen SplatPanel always passes autoFocus, so keyboard browsing through results (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in the studio Viewer) stops at every splat. The focused splat stage takes the arrows and calls preventDefault, and the Viewer's window handler ignores events that were already handled (ignoreKey: e.defaultPrevented). The GLB model-viewer path never takes focus, so this is new behaviour.
findings.failureScenario: In the Library's 3D tab, open a splat and press ArrowRight. Focus is on 'Look around the splat' (role=application), and the key orbits the splat instead of going to the next result. Browsing to another splat grabs focus again. I checked this in demo mode with Chromium/SwiftShader: after ArrowRight the same .ply was still open. Blurring and pressing ArrowRight moved to the next result (the .spz). Fix: drop autoFocus in the panel, or only auto-focus when the panel was opened by 'View in 3D' / 'Look around in 3D'. Another option is to let ArrowLeft/Right through when the stage was focused programmatically and the user hasn't interacted with it yet.

findings.summary: dispose() calls renderer.dispose() but not renderer.forceContextLoss(). Every card that opens and closes the splat viewer leaves a live WebGL2 context until GC, and nothing handles webglcontextlost.
findings.failureScenario: On the Image to 3D feed, someone opens '3D' on many splat cards one after another (the canvas is recreated on each toggle). Chrome's limit of about 16 contexts makes it drop the oldest with 'Too many active WebGL contexts', and the viewer that is open can then go blank with no fallback note. I traced this from the code but did not reproduce the exhaustion. Fix: call this.renderer.forceContextLoss() in dispose(), and optionally show the fallback note on webglcontextlost.

fix.finalSummary: idol-4 is ready for docs and merge. People can look around Gaussian splats on result cards, in the full-screen viewer and in the Library's 3D tab, with Spark 2.3.1 (MIT) loaded only by dynamic import. The fixes in this stage: the arrow keys keep browsing results in the full-screen viewer until the user engages the splat, closed viewers give their WebGL context back and a lost context shows the fallback, 'Save a still' stays hidden until the viewer is known, there is a unit test for the open-engine demo splat, and stale comments and the ARCHITECTURE.md mock sentence are corrected. Verified only with the demo .spz; a real run needs a GPU. Cloud: fal's TripoSplat and Idol .ply open in the same viewer, verified only with the demo .ply; a real run needs a fal key. Public sign-up: guests can look around any splat they can see but get no 'Save a still', and the server would refuse it anyway.
